background_execution.description: Background execution for V3 sessions. One flag turns on both sides because, whenever it is on, the TUI sends backgroundExecution: { enabled: true } on session/new: the CLI display (shells chip, transcript rows for finished background processes, Ctrl+B to move a running command to the background, the Ctrl+G Shells monitor) and, from that setting, the agent's background layer itself (managed run_in_background, the move at the timeout, completion wakes, the control tool disclosed once a process runs, monitors, PTY). KAS reads no KIRO_ENABLED_FEATURES; a KAS reached without the CLI is enabled by its own operator override, KIRO_FEATURE_BACKGROUND_EXECUTION_ENABLED=true. Off, CLI and agent behave exactly as before the feature existed. Dark-shipped at 0% until the telemetry layer ramps it for internal users on the nightly channel; treatment_percent is the dial and the kill switch. Opt in anywhere with KIRO_ENABLED_FEATURES.

c2s.description: Code-to-Spec Explore agent and analysis pipeline. Internal nightly only; the rollout exposes Explore and the settings control, while chat.enableC2s enables the analysis tools.

cloud_config.description: Cloud config: the consolidated /config panel, cloud/local source labels on config listings, and the launcher passing the stage-default cloud-config BFF endpoint to KAS for local V3 sessions. Turning this off hides the UI and stops the launcher supplying that stage default, so KAS makes no cloud-config calls unless the user explicitly sets a trusted-host CLOUD_CONFIG_ENDPOINT override (which applies regardless of the rollout). GA: ramped to 100% for ALL users on every channel; per-user activation stays governed by KAS's server-side AB_CLOUD_CONFIG entitlement, so non-entitled users see local-only sources. This flag is retained purely as the client-side kill switch: to darken the fleet, set treatment_percent to 0 in a follow-up release (config is compiled in); the immediate per-user lever is KIRO_FEATURE_CLOUD_CONFIG_ENABLED, an env override read by the KAS server (kiro-agent's feature-config provider), not by this crate.

infra_safety.description: ICECAP infrastructure-safety gate (monitor/enforce). Internal-only initially; launcher exports KIRO_INFRA_SAFETY_ROLLOUT_ENABLED and the TUI advertises the capability + honors the infraSafety settings only when enabled. Ramp via treatment_percent.

kvim.description: /kvim: Neovim in a pane above the fullscreen chat. The launcher includes kvim in KIRO_ENABLED_FEATURES and the TUI registers the /kvim command only when enabled. Internal users on every channel; dial treatment_percent to 0 to kill-switch. Opt in anywhere with KIRO_ENABLED_FEATURES.

lite.description: Lite TUI mode - all channels, Amazon employees only

local_sandbox.description: CLI LocalSandbox on V3 (the --sandbox flag, /sandbox, and local /autonomous). Generally available to all users on every channel. Dial treatment_percent to 0 to kill-switch (config is compiled in, so that ships in the next release).

managed_settings.description: Organization-managed settings display on V3: the /config managed category and subcommand, organization Source labels on /config, /mcp and /hooks rows, the organization-disabled/unavailable/hidden MCP row, the registry-hidden /mcp notice, the _kiro/governance/state subscription feeding them (off: the TUI reads only the web-tools toggle from it, as before), and the pre-session _kiro/config/template mode seed. Admin enforcement is not gated: KAS enforces governance itself. Dark-shipped at 0%; ramp internal nightly first via treatment_percent, which is also the kill switch. Opt in anywhere with KIRO_ENABLED_FEATURES='["managed_settings"]'.

memory.description: Persistent agent memory and the /memories command. Generally available to all users on every channel; memory starts off for external users until they opt in, and KAS's memory experiment still decides per-user eligibility.

memory_controls.description: KAS-only /memories controls: saved memory access and automatic-update defaults, plus record browsing (list, preview, detail). Generally available to all users on every channel; set treatment_percent to 0 to darken it.

remote_changelog.description: Remote changelog feed fetch on stable builds (prod CloudFront). Nightly always fetches from gamma unconditionally. GA: all stable users at 100%. To darken the fleet, set treatment_percent to 0 in a follow-up release (config is compiled in); the immediate per-user lever is KIRO_NO_REMOTE_CHANGELOG.

remote_sandbox.description: Remote/cloud sandbox sessions (--cloud/--repo flags). Ramped to 100% for all users on every channel. Dial treatment_percent to 0 to kill-switch (re-darkens the flags in the next release).

session_dashboard.description: Session dashboard: the /sessions browser, --sessions flag, and --resume-picker dashboard routing (v3). Generally available: every user on every channel. treatment_percent stays at 100 rather than ramping, because the single per-feature percent buckets internal users too — a partial percent would drop the feature for the internal cohort it was already ramped to. Dial treatment_percent to 0 to kill-switch (config is compiled in, so that ships in the next release). The surface is V3-only, but --sessions selects V3 itself, so the flag is not bounded by a separate engine choice; a user who saved or passed a non-V3 engine is told the dashboard needs V3 rather than being moved onto it.

standalone_toolbox.description: Autocomplete decoupling cohort: the bundled Toolbox post-install hook asks this flag whether to move a user onto the standalone channel. It does not gate update routing, which always keeps a standalone binary on standalone archives. Starts at 0%; ramp treatment_percent in later releases. Lowering it stops new enrollment but does not move already-migrated users back.

tangent.description: /tangent named side-conversations. Generally available; the launcher includes tangent in KIRO_ENABLED_FEATURES and the TUI registers the /tangent command only when enabled. Dial treatment_percent to 0 to kill-switch.

test_internal_only.description: Test experiment for unit tests (internal only)

test_nightly_only.description: Test experiment for unit tests (nightly channel only)

trust_classifier_shadow.description: Permission-classifier shadow mode: on every approval prompt the engine also asks the permission-classifier model for a verdict and records it beside the human's decision, never changing the prompt. Internal nightly only. Per-user opt-out is the trust.classifier.shadow setting; the launcher exports the combined decision as KIRO_TRUST_CLASSIFIER_SHADOW; today only the V2 engine reads it (V3 is planned). Dial treatment_percent to 0 to kill-switch.

tui.description: Gradual rollout of the new React/Ink TUI to replace legacy terminal UI

v3_prompt.description: Who is offered the V3 ease-in prompt. Internal users ramp at internal_treatment_percent and everyone else at treatment_percent. treatment_percent 0 darkens every percentage-bucketed user, internal included; fully stopping the prompt also requires clearing v3_prompt.treatment in rollout_overrides.json. To withdraw external users while keeping internal users at internal_treatment_percent, set segment back to internal. There is no feature that flips the default engine to V3 during the ease-in — the prompt is the only path — so a user is never defaulted onto V3 without being asked. Answers already given are honored via the persisted chat.agentEngine setting.
